purpose: Checkbox-by-checkbox audit of SzeChunYiu/ORION#76 against origin/main. Tick only boxes verified on main. Empirical gates A-F remain unticked because the frozen #8 packet is unbound and no Phase-2 closure subject exists.
discriminators: P2 in papers/paper-02-* and .github/workflows/p2-*.yml is Paper 2, not Phase 2.
A passing unit test is STRUCTURE_ONLY relative to a #76 gate. Gates ask for properties demonstrated on the frozen closure subject.
BLOCKED_EXTERNAL is reserved for provisioning. Code-side defects demonstrated on a non-closure subject remain STRUCTURE_ONLY plus a cited defect, not MERGED_EVIDENCE.
Ancestry of origin/main from the Phase-1 anchor is necessary and not sufficient for DEP2.
